messages:
Sam (Partnerships): Onboarding check for partner SkyForge. They want AWS+GCP listing, 14-day trial, and EU residency option. Quick triage?
Diego (CloudOps): Need their manifest, artifact buckets, and whether they want logs forwarded to our telemetry or retained in their account.
Sam (Partnerships): Manifest uploaded to shared drive. They requested read-only access to s3://skyforge-artifacts and a webhook at https://hooks.skyforge.io/metrics. No write access.
Priya (Legal): Telemetry question: will payloads include IPs/emails? If yes we need DPI review and retention terms.
Omar (Product): Packaging: create `skyforge-core` (metered), `skyforge-trial-14d` (trial), and `seat-pack-5`. Need three pricing bands.
Rae (Engineering): Entitlement mapping proposal: map `skyforge.trial_expires` and `skyforge.max_concurrent`. We'll provide token-exchange example for their devs.
listing-bot: manifest lint: missing `privacy_summary` and `screenshots` in manifest.json. See https://redwood.infra/listing-checks/1829999999
Diego (CloudOps): IAM snippet to share with publisher:
Role: redwood-pub-skyforge-readonly
Permissions: s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket (scoped to skyforge-artifacts)
Trust: publisher-account-id
Sam (Partnerships): @Priya partner says telemetry only contains hashed session_id + app_version, retention 30 days. Priya?
Priya (Legal): Hashes acceptable; need publisher confirmation in writing and signed addendum. Retention <=30 days OK.
Omar (Product): Timeline: 1) get screenshots + privacy blurb 2) CloudOps creates IAM + staging 3) Eng validates manifest + runs token exchange 4) Legal signs addendum 5) Product publishes SKU copy. Target: staging next Wednesday.
Rae (Engineering): I'll run manifest validator as soon as assets land. Sharing token-exchange cURL for their team.
Sam (Partnerships): Thanks — I'll chase screenshots and the written telemetry confirmation. :thumbsup:
